verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents user-controlled lifecycle actions that govern where data lives and when it is removed. Users can destroy instances via the CLI, keep data in persistent volumes that outlive instances and manage them from the Storage page, copy data off stopped instances, and clean up after a run. However, nothing describes a data-retention policy, guaranteed deletion or wiping on third-party host machines, or account-data deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented retention policy and windows, verified secure deletion/wiping of data on host disks after destroy, account/personal-data deletion controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: `vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
Volumes provide persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances.
The Storage page allows you to easily access and manage your volumes
While an instance is stopped, your instance is detached from its GPU(s), but your data can still be copied off the machine.
